translated: Everyone cares so much about each other, they're all such good kids.
Because they're facing each other properly, I think their feelings will continue to grow in all sorts of ways from here on out.
I don't know for sure yet, so this is just my own personal take on it.
But I'm planning to keep watching over them as they grow.
I'd be happy if you'd join me in watching over Leo/need and Saki-chan too.
Thank you so much for today.
By the way, for those who haven't finished the story for "Stars Twinkle in the Night Sky We Look Up At" yet,
you can read it all in the Event Stories menu once the next event starts.
Please go give it a read.
You can read it as many times as you want, after all.
And with that, it's already time to say goodbye.
I always wonder if I've left anything unsaid, but I think I've talked quite a lot.
I hope my feelings reached all of you, even just a little bit.
Thank you so much for sticking with me until the very end.
Well then, see you again next time!
